quote: Neto made his professional debut in 2008 with Minas Tênis Clube during the 2008–09 FIBA Americas League.
On August 5, 2023, Neto signed a one-year deal with Fenerbahçe Beko. (not in the infobox; no games on Basketball-Reference - left out)
On October 15, 2024, Neto returned to Brazil as he signed a contract with Pinheiros Basquete.
Neto was announced as a new FC Barcelona player on November 24, 2024, signing a contract for the remainder of the season.
On July 3, 2025, Neto was announced as a new player by San Pablo Burgos of the Liga ACB.
